g.title: delft3d4_communication
g.text: Delft3D4 online: Delft3D4 controls time, synchronized file exchange

g.title: read
g.text: Read wave fields at Delft3D4 read point

g.title: finish
g.text: End: Delft3D4 sends DelftIO finalize; both components clean up.
Solid: file I/O / local sequence. Dashed: inter-component control.
* Requires WriteCOM (mandatory online); Delft3D4 input selections are independent.

g.title: swan
g.text: read results; map wave fields if WriteCOM

g.title: mud
g.text: D-Waves waits for water + mud and reports completion to both.
One water domain + one mud domain, identical grids.

g.title: diagram_credit
g.text: Created with Copilot from prompts, using existing code as reference.
